evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies Tor control protocol handling in src/torcontrol.cpp, which is explicitly covered under Tor integration.
rationale: Validates Tor service IDs and keys to prevent Tor command injection and DoS. As noted in the description, unescaped quoted keys containing CRLF or spaces allowed an impersonated endpoint to inject Tor commands such as `SIGNAL SHUTDOWN` via cached keys.
